3: # Cloud Hosting Services Agreement
5: Parties: PayRo SRL and Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL
6: Contract ID: CTR-2023-001
7: Status: active · Effective: 2023-03-01 · Renewal: 2026-03-01
8: Services: cloud hosting of the production payment platform and document storage
9: Supports a critical or important function: yes
13: ## 1. Services and functions
14: The Provider hosts the PayRo payment platform. Subcontracting of a critical function requires PayRo's prior written consent.
16: ## 2. Locations of data processing
17: Services are provided and data is processed and stored in Germany and Ireland. The Provider notifies PayRo in advance of any change of location.
19: ## 3. Data protection
20: The Provider ensures the availability, authenticity, integrity and confidentiality of PayRo data, including personal data.
22: ## 4. Access, recovery and return of data
23: On insolvency, discontinuation or termination, PayRo can access, recover and receive all its data in an easily accessible format.
25: ## 5. Service levels
26: Service level: 99.95% monthly availability, with quantitative performance targets and service credits. Service levels are reviewed yearly.
28: ## 6. Assistance in ICT incidents
29: The Provider assists PayRo at no additional cost when an ICT incident related to the services occurs.
31: ## 7. Cooperation with competent authorities
32: The Provider fully cooperates with the competent authorities and resolution authorities of PayRo.
34: ## 8. Termination
35: PayRo may terminate with 90 days' notice, or immediately on a material breach.
37: ## 9. Security awareness and training
38: Provider staff take part in PayRo's ICT security awareness programmes and digital operational resilience training.
40: ## 10. Notice and reporting obligations
40: The Provider reports without delay any development that may materially affect its ability to meet the agreed service levels.","obligation":"The Cloud Hosting Services Agreement complies with Art. 30 requirements for contracts supporting critical or important functions, including service levels, reporting, contingency plans, TLPT participation, and audit rights.","action":"CONTRACT_REVIEW","confidence":1}
